title: An Informetric Analysis of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) Research Literature
content: The paper analysed the mathematical patterns underlying the rapid growth of research literature on Generative AI. Using a mathematical informetrics-based approach, it explored how publication, citation and collaboration structures are evolving within this emerging field. The paper uncovered generalizable insights into the organization of scientific knowledge and demonstrated how mathematical informetrics can inform understanding of research dynamics in Generative AI.
